request.text: Find a new blue iPad with the A16 chip, Wi-Fi only and 128 GB, delivered to Beirut.

message:
Best confirmed match: Technodel — $475.00, in stock, new, blue, A16, Wi-Fi and 128GB. Delivery to Beirut is $4.
Lower-priced option: Mobileleb — $458.00 for the in-stock Blue / Brand New / 1 Year variant. Its listing specifies Wi-Fi, but Beirut delivery availability and fees could not be confirmed from its published shipping page.
I suggest Technodel for the clearest verified match and delivery terms.
